<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex87012023-03-0911-21-20" status="unreviewed">dang po ni | <quote n="2.1b">tshul gsum rtags las don mthong yin</quote>| (PVin 2.1b)_zhes pa'i tshul gsum po de gang zhe na  tshul gsum po'i ya gyal phyogs chos de ni rtags chos can rjes su dpag bya la yod par nges pa'o || ya gyal rtags kyi rjes 'gro'i <lb n="43b9"/> khyab pa de ni rtags chos can de dang bsgrub bya'i chos yod tu mtshungs pa nyid la yang yod par nges pa'o || 
    dang ni tshigs bcad la ma shong ba yin la | nyid ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsha ba</rs>'i 'gyur la chad pa yin te | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5551">dz+nya na shri</rs>'i 'gyur las | rjes dpag bya dang de mthun la | yod dang med nyid la med par | nges pa | ces 'byung ngo || </seg></TEI>
